title: Amazon Prime Student UK: 6 months free, then £4.49 a month (who qualifies)

description: Prime Student UK: six months free, then £4.49 a month or £47.49 a year, for UK students and all 18–24s. Plus the best Black Friday buys for students.
intro:
**Short answer: Amazon Prime Student gives UK and Irish higher-education students of any age, and anyone in the UK aged 18 to 24 (student or not), a six-month free trial. After that it's £4.49 a month or £47.49 a year, half the normal Prime price, with the same Prime Video, free delivery and Amazon Music.**

Terms are from Amazon's Prime Student page, updated 19 November 2026. Start it now and six free months take you through Black Friday Week (to 30 November), Christmas and the January sales. The deals below are Amazon UK Black Friday Week prices reported by TechRadar and T3 on 24 and 25 November 2026, picked for student budgets and small rooms.

body:
## Prime Student at a glance

- **Free trial:** six months.
- **After the trial:** £4.49 a month or £47.49 a year. Full Prime is £8.99 a month or £95 a year, so it's half price.
- **Who qualifies:** students at a UK or Irish university or college of higher education, of any age, plus everyone in the UK aged 18 to 24, whether they study or not.
- **What you get:** the same benefits as full Prime (fast free delivery, Prime Video, Amazon Music, Prime Reading), plus young-adult perks.

## Who can get Prime Student?

Amazon widened Prime Student so it isn't only for people with a university email. There are two routes:

1. **Higher-education students**, enrolled at a university or college in the UK or Republic of Ireland. Age doesn't matter, so mature and postgraduate students qualify.
2. **Anyone in the UK aged 18 to 24**, in education or not. Apprentices, people in work and gap-year students all count.

School and sixth-form pupils who aren't in higher education have to wait until they turn 18. Amazon may ask you to confirm your student status or age when you sign up.

## What's included

You get everything a full Prime member gets:

- **Free fast delivery** on Prime items, which is the main saving if you order essentials to halls.
- **Prime Video** with adverts (ad-free is £2.99 a month extra). See [what's on Prime Video in December](/guides/prime-video-free-trial-uk/).
- **Amazon Music** (the Prime version) and **Prime Reading**.
- **Student and young-adult extras.** Amazon currently lists a National Express travel discount, 10% off selected fashion brands, 10% off textbooks, and ODEON two-for-£10 cinema tickets. These change, so check the Prime Student page.

## Is it worth it?

For most students, yes. The trial costs nothing for six months, and £4.49 a month afterwards is less than a single delivery charge on a few small orders. The free delivery alone covers it if you order more than once a month.

Two things to watch:

- **It renews automatically.** At the end of six months you'll pay £4.49 a month unless you cancel. Put a reminder in your phone for a few days before.
- **It ends when you stop qualifying.** When you leave higher education and are over 24, the discount stops and you'd move to full Prime unless you cancel.

## Start it now for Black Friday

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Monday 30 November. Prime isn't needed for most of the deals, but free fast delivery on small orders and member-only offers are. A trial started today runs until late May 2027, covering Black Friday, Christmas, the January sales and the summer term.

See our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/) for the best deals, updated three times a day, or browse [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

## Two more Amazon trials worth knowing about

- **Audible:** Audible's Black Friday offer is £0.99 a month for three months for eligible members, until 17 December. It's good for long commutes and set texts. See our [Audible deal guide](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/).
- **Kindle Unlimited:** a 30-day free trial for heavy readers. See [Kindle Unlimited free trial UK](/guides/kindle-unlimited-free-trial-uk/).

## How to cancel Prime Student

Go to **Your Account → Prime Membership → Manage → Update, cancel and more**, and end your membership. If you cancel during the free trial you won't be charged.

## FAQs

### How long is the Amazon Prime Student free trial?

Six months. After that it costs £4.49 a month or £47.49 a year unless you cancel.

### How much is Prime Student in the UK?

£4.49 a month or £47.49 a year after the free trial, half the price of full Prime (£8.99 a month or £95 a year).

### Can you get Prime Student without being a student?

Yes, if you live in the UK and are aged 18 to 24. Amazon's young-adult discount uses the same price and trial, whether you study or not.

### Does Prime Student include Prime Video?

Yes. You get the same Prime Video as full Prime members, with adverts. Ad-free viewing costs £2.99 a month extra.

### What happens to Prime Student when I graduate?

If you're still 24 or under, you keep qualifying through the young-adult route. Once you no longer qualify, the discount ends and full Prime is £8.99 a month, so check your membership page and cancel if you don't want it.
